purpose: Compare 1+0, 2+1, and 3+1 firewall protocols under one explicit symbolic p/q/p_loss location model, charging HOLD and QUARANTINE as yield loss.
evidence_scope: CANDIDATE benchmark protocol only; no stochastic result has been evaluated.

syndrome_ancilla.epoch: after final entangling interaction and before syndrome measurement

flag_ancilla.epoch: after final flag interaction and before flag measurement

classical_processing.scope: syndrome-coordinate transform, majority/equality logic, Pauli-frame lookup and outcome classification are ideal in this first stochastic benchmark

p_model.meaning: independent Bernoulli fault probability at each declared non-measurement quantum fault location
p_model.two_qubit_conditional_fault: conditioned on a p event after an ideal two-qubit gate, choose uniformly from the 15 nonidentity two-qubit Paulis
p_model.single_qubit_conditional_fault: conditioned on a p event after a one-qubit basis rotation, ancilla prepare/reset, or data idle location, choose X/Y/Z uniformly
p_model.same_p_for_all_location_types: declared simplifying benchmark assumption; not a hardware calibration claim

q_model.meaning: independent Bernoulli classical bit-flip probability on each declared binary measurement result after the ideal measurement
q_model.edge_measurement_note: edge values remain redundant receipts and do not enter the frozen center recovery lookup; their q faults are still counted as physical measurement errors

p_loss_model.meaning: independent Bernoulli loss event at each declared loss location
p_loss_model.detection: ideal and immediate at the declared detection epoch
p_loss_model.hardware_interpretation: none; this is a benchmark assumption

joint_fault_semantics.independence: p, q, and p_loss elementary events are mutually independent across distinct declared locations
joint_fault_semantics.two_fault_definition: exactly two elementary stochastic events at two distinct location IDs; all other locations ideal
joint_fault_semantics.two_qubit_pauli_with_both_qubits_noniden: one p fault event, not two faults
joint_fault_semantics.loss_plus_other_fault_same_check: allowed when location IDs are distinct; ideal-detected loss determines HOLD/QUARANTINE outcome even if another fault also occurs
joint_fault_semantics.nominal_location_universe: all scheduled rounds are used to define the pair universe, independent of early HOLD/QUARANTINE
joint_fault_semantics.adaptive_fail_fast_resource_model: not used to define fault exposure; may later be reported only as a secondary expected-resource analysis without changing outcome probabilities

1+0.pre_recovery_fail_closed: any detected loss or center flag => HOLD/QUARANTINE
1+0.recovery: map b to frozen s coordinates and apply frozen decoder as Pauli frame
1+0.acceptance: if complete/unflagged/loss-free, ACCEPT immediately after recovery

2+1.syndrome_estimator: the two complete unflagged center frames must agree bit-for-bit; disagreement => HOLD
2+1.pre_recovery_fail_closed: any detected loss or center flag => HOLD/QUARANTINE
2+1.recovery: apply frozen decoder to the agreed center frame
2+1.verification: one fresh round; ACCEPT only if complete/unflagged/loss-free and center syndrome relative to updated Pauli frame is 0000; otherwise HOLD/QUARANTINE

3+1.syndrome_estimator: bitwise majority of three complete unflagged center frames
3+1.pre_recovery_fail_closed: any detected loss or center flag => HOLD/QUARANTINE
3+1.recovery: apply frozen decoder to the majority center frame
3+1.verification: one fresh round; ACCEPT only if complete/unflagged/loss-free and center syndrome relative to updated Pauli frame is 0000; otherwise HOLD/QUARANTINE

primary_workload.initial_state: clean encoded protected logical state with arbitrary gauge state
campaigns: every unordered pair of distinct elementary fault locations with full declared conditional Pauli expansion
primary_workload.no_numeric_parameter_values: The first report will be exact symbolic/rational coefficient ledgers in p,q,p_loss through total degree two; no fitted or hardware-interpreted numerical point.

accepted_shot_scoring.analysis_only_ideal_cleanup: after operational protocol ends, use the frozen ideal decoder only for scoring residual syndrome; this does not add an operational recovery round
accepted_shot_scoring.logical_failure_L: after analysis-only cleanup, protected logical quotient is X, Y, or Z rather than I

secondary_metrics.Y_clean: P(ACCEPT and dressed residual weight=0 and not L)
secondary_metrics.expected_executed_two_qubit_gates_if_fai: secondary analysis only; cannot redefine fault universe

comparison_rule.same_hold_quarantine_treatment: both are yield loss and never successful correction
comparison_rule.winner_not_single_scalar: report Pareto comparison in (Y, epsilon_L_given_A, Y_good, resource cost); do not declare a winner by epsilon alone
comparison_rule.round_count_optimization_after_exposure: new candidate requiring new version and fresh evaluation

not_in_first_stochastic_model: stale or missing metadata faults with nonzero probability
leakage not represented as ideal-detected loss
correlated multi-location noise beyond independent Bernoulli locations
stop_rules: Do not evaluate any numerical p,q,p_loss point and call it physical without calibration.
Do not count HOLD or QUARANTINE as correction success.
Do not change 2+1 equality rule or 3+1 majority rule after exposure.
Do not change conditional Pauli distributions after exposure.
Do not optimize round count on these results and call it confirmatory.
